articles.title: Revanth: PRTS Line From LB Stadium To Ranigunj, Tenders In Dec, Operations In A Year
articles.description: The Chief Minister said PRTS could provide a convenient and efficient last-mile and short-distance public transport option in densely populated and congested parts of Hyderabad. The system uses small automated vehicles operating on dedicated guideways, allowing passengers to travel directly to their destinations without the frequent stops and fixed routes associated with conventional buses
